description: Email each person who has an address their own private link, using the site's normal mail flow and the same daily cap (EMAIL_DAILY_CAP) and per-network limit as the website. Does not return the links or who gives to whom. Fails clearly when email is off or the draw is not done.

admin_token.description: Organizer secret returned by create_draw: the token, or the full /m/ URL. It cannot reveal who gives to whom.

language.description: Language of the reply and the share messages: en, es, ca, de, pt, fr, it, nl, pl, da, no, sv, ru, ko, ja. Defaults from region.

region.description: Region code from list_regions (US, ES, CT for Catalonia, DE, MX, …). Sets the local name of the game, the default language and the currency.

name: send_invites
title: Send email invites
